Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Copper NPT Cooling
Description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible molten Copper structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate quenching process of Copper by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the cooled structure and density in gm/cm^3.

Required submission format:
{"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- path to molten structure: /structures/task_29/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat
- units: metal
- pbc: true
- timestep: 1 femtosecond
- npt quench steps: 20000
- npt quench initial temperature: 2000
- npt quench final temperature: 300
- npt quench pressure: 0
- npt quench thermostat: Nose-Hoover
- npt quench barostat: Nose-Hoover
- atom_style: atomic

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/copper_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching_trial_4 when using tools use this path.
